About Us

Mangaluru's Trusted Car & Bike Care Since 2017

Zain Car & Bike Wash started in 2017 with a simple promise — give every vehicle the same care we'd give our own. Located on Nandigudda Road in Attavar, we've been keeping Mangaluru's cars and bikes clean, shiny and protected ever since.

Whether it's a quick weekly wash, a deep interior clean or a full detailing job, our team works carefully on every corner of your ride.
